title_en: Federal Law No. 7 of 2025 Regarding Agricultural Quarantine
title_ar: القانون الاتحادي رقم 7 لسنة 2025 بشأن الحجر الزراعي
summary: Establishes federal agricultural quarantine framework to prevent introduction/spread of regulated pests and protect plant resources; regulates agricultural consignments and phytosanitary measures.
legal_disclaimer: Informational summary only; current requirements must be confirmed through the official authority and latest consolidated legislation.

title_en: Federal Law No. 10 of 2020 Regarding Pesticides
title_ar: قانون اتحادي رقم 10 لسنة 2020 بشأن المبيدات
summary: Sets federal objectives and scope for agricultural/public-health pesticides and active substances, including registration, importation, circulation, use, control and safe disposal.
